notes.title: Patch notes - Cairn demo
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We're coming back with an update to the demo! We are introducing a few new features and fixing quite a few bugs. Have a read for details![/p][p][/p][p][u]New features:[/u][/p][list][*][p]You can now [b]heal your fingers[/b] in the bivouac using climbing tape[/p][/*][*][p]Your Climbot can now [b]compost[/b] trash and items, and produce some very useful chalk![/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]remap the controls[/b] to accommodate your play style[/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]jump rappel and slide rappel[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]You can now browse all the [b]letters[/b] and papers you find in your backpack[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050904/42ab2e6793f0cd0da52311938607cb35219d6d35.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]Fixes and improvements:[/u][/p][list][*][p]Our Climbot friend should find its way even better now[/p][/*][*][p]Saving: new a load menu and possibility to load save from pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Camera: new special camera when entering bivouac[/p][/*][*][p]Audio: new barks, several audio improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorials: new tutorial on how to use the light on the staff[/p][/*][*][p]Settings: new gameplay settings (save reminder, hold feedback..)[/p][/*][*][p]Dualsense: improvement to haptic / trigger effect / speaker...[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: No more rope between Aava and Climbot if no piton planted[/p][/*][*][p]Changes to rope swinging[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization for performance[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]All of this is available in version [b]1.0.94_945.[/b][/p][p] We hope you'll enjoy these changes, as usual, let us know your thoughts here in the comments or on our Discord.[/p][p]Thank you for playing the demo and getting ready for the ascent of Mount Kami in a few months now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050904/04ac2d7c621360c3950d3b7bf0a29dd4417651cf.jpg"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: You can now heal your fingers in the bivouac using climbing tape
Your Climbot can now compost trash and items, and produce some very useful chalk!
You can now remap the controls to accommodate your play style
You can now jump rappel and slide rappel
You can now browse all the letters and papers you find in your backpack

tags.bug: Fix: No more rope between Aava and Climbot if no piton planted

notes.title: Patch notes - Cairn demo - 0.2.13_723
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're back with a demo update, and improvements a lot of you have been requesting!

Most of the time, it's good to rely on the game's calculations to select the best limb to move next. It's smooth and efficient. But there's always this [b]one[/b] time where you want total control. We heard you. So we are introducing  [b]New manual limb selection modes![/b] Not one, not two, but four different control schemes to suit all playstyles!

These are the different modes to pick from: face buttons and shoulder buttons on gamepad, WASD on keyboard, and a quadrant selection on both.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050904/18501bdd4b23c886df0d6549bc363fc6c2d463a8.jpg[/img]

After some testing, we think these are the best ways to let you manually control the limbs, but of course we'd love to hear what you think about it.

This update is also introducing Korean localization, welcome Korean players!

We have also fixed a few bugs:
[list]
[*] Manual limb selection: improved limb detection when selecting with the stick, added a visual helper
[*] Some fixes on the rope to avoid weird movement
[*] Fixed several low reproduction soft lock
[*] Fixed PS4 controller displaying Xbox inputs
[*] Fixed off-belay detection
[*] Fixed camera going through ground during recap path
[*] Minor LD fixes to avoid being stuck in narrow spaces
[*] Minor localization fixes and missing prompts
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes - Cairn Demo - 0.1.262s_587
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Thank you so much for playing Cairn's demo, and sharing your screenshots, routes and feedback with us!

It is incredible to see you all enjoy the demo, and find new routes we hadn't been able to play ourselves.

We are still working on the full game, and patching the demo thanks to all of your feedback!

Here are the fixes that have been pushed in our last update: 
[list]
[*] Fixed a low reproduction soft lock during the off belay transition
[*] Fixed a low reproduction soft lock if a tutorial triggered during a No Go Area teleportation
[*] Fixed a low reproduction soft lock if the barometer is opened during a No Go Area teleportation
[*] Fixed a bug on mantling in overhangs
[*] Fixed an input menu issue when other control devices are detected
[*] Minor localization fixes
[/list]
Here are some quality of life updates:
[list]
[*] Use native resolution on all quality settings for SteamDeck (still not optimized, low performance on SteamDeck)
[*] Improve bivouac interaction visibility
[/list]
